name: Aphex
description: Connect your AI tool to your construction delivery data in Aphex — ask questions and draft reports grounded in the live site record.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aphex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aphex to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.aphex.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aphex MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aphex provides these MCP tools: aphex_list_projects, aphex_list_diary_entries, and aphex_get_diary_entries.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aphex?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aphex in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Aphex requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aphex is developed by Aphex. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
